name: Box: The power of Content + AI

ios.desc:
Take your content anywhere with Box, the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Seamlessly capture, scan, access, create, edit, annotate, and share your most important content—all secured with enterprise-grade protection.

With Box, you can:
• Use Box AI: ask questions, summarize documents, and automate workflows
• Manage files: upload, view, and search hundreds of file types with offline access
• Capture content: scan documents with OCR, take photos/videos, and record audio
• Collaborate: share files, co-edit Box Notes, annotate documents, and transcribe handwriting
• Secure data: protect files with enterprise encryption and compliance controls

–

** Featured by Apple in Best New Apps and Best New Business Apps
** “Box is an excellent choice for viewing, editing and sharing your files securely in the cloud.” ‐ CNET

Use Box AI on mobile:
• Access powerful AI tools directly within the app to ask questions, summarize documents, and extract insights instantly
• Switch between AI agents, clear chat history, and give feedback on AI responses to optimize your experience
• View source citations to verify answers and use formatting options for clearer, structured responses
• Access Box AI on your mobile device with Business, Business Plus, or any of the Enterprise plans

Manage and quickly locate files:
• Upload and view hundreds of file types including PDFs, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace documents, and more
• Create Box Notes for ideas, to-do lists, and real-time project coordination
• Work offline with seamless access to files and folders
• Search instantly by file name and content type
• Edit, e-sign, annotate your work

Scan and capture:
• Scan documents with OCR to convert files into searchable PDFs
• Capture, edit, and enhance photos directly from your device
• Record audio and video with pause/resume controls before uploading

Collaborate and share:
• Share files with teammates or external collaborators securely with one click
• Work together in real time with Box Notes
• Annotate documents with typed or drawn feedback
• Convert handwriting to text using Apple Pencil on iPad
• Seamlessly content to partner app integrations

Secure your files and protect privacy:
• Prevent leaks across company and personal devices
• Enterprise-level security, compliance, and file encryption
• Choose flexible EMM options for device or app-level control

Your subscription will renew automatically each month and payment will be charged to your iTunes Account withi
